name: la-plage-digitale
description: The La Plage Digitale website — a Sovrium app declared entirely in app.yaml and served by a long-running Sovrium process.

SOVRIUM_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Root secret. Sovrium generates its own key when none is given, but Scalingo rebuilds the container filesystem on every deploy and restart, so a self-generated key would be new each time. The session-signing secret derives from it, so AUTH_SECRET is never set alongside. Each review app gets its own key rather than the parent's.

BASE_URL.description: Public origin of this app. A non-loopback value is what switches on secure cookies and CSRF enforcement. The url generator fills in the app's own address, so a review app points at itself instead of at production.

NODE_ENV.description: Turns on immutable caching for content-hashed assets. Without it every asset is returned no-store and the browser refetches the whole bundle on each page view.

TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS.description: Number of reverse proxies in front of the app. 1 accounts for Scalingo's own router, so rate limits count per visitor instead of lumping every request onto the router's address. Raise it only if you put your own CDN in front of Scalingo.

AUTH_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Email of the administrator seeded on first boot against a fresh database. Seeding needs both this and AUTH_ADMIN_PASSWORD, and only runs when the config declares an auth block. On later boots it no-ops: it never duplicates and never modifies an existing user.

AUTH_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the seeded administrator, minimum 8 characters. Generated per app so a review app never shares production's admin credentials. Read it back with `scalingo --app <name> env`.

NOTION_TOKEN.description: Notion internal integration token read by the weekly digest automation (notion-hebdo). Set it with scalingo env-set before deploying: a missing required variable refuses to boot.

SLACK_BOT_TOKEN.description: Bot token (xoxb-…) of the Slack app that posts the weekly Notion digest in #notion-hebdo.

NOTION_TASKS_DATA_SOURCE_ID.description: Data source id of « Suivi des sujets, projets & tâches » in the V2 Notion.

NOTION_METRICS_DATA_SOURCE_ID.description: Data source id of « Indicateurs d'usage Notion ». Leave empty to skip the weekly metrics row.

SOVRIUM_TIMEZONE.description: Timezone of cron automations and formatted dates.
